description: Two tiny nullable tables for NULL/3VL, duplicates, empty and grouped SUM/COUNT, joins on NULL keys, subqueries, result types and scales, text caveats, and one run-time SQL error.

ddl.sql:
CREATE TABLE r (k integer, v numeric(10,2), tag text);
CREATE TABLE s (k integer, w integer);

cases.name: filter_3vl_duplicates
cases.sql: SELECT k, v, tag FROM r WHERE NOT (v < 1)
cases.note: NOT UNKNOWN is UNKNOWN, so the NULL-v row is dropped; the duplicate row stays twice.

cases.name: empty_sum_count
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(v) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(v) AS nv FROM r WHERE k > 100
cases.note: Scalar aggregate over no rows: one row, SUM NULL, COUNTs 0.

cases.name: group_null_key
cases.sql: SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(v) AS nv, SUM(v) AS total FROM r GROUP BY k
cases.note: NULL keys form one group; COUNT(*) vs COUNT(v); SUM over only NULLs is NULL.

cases.name: join_null_keys_duplicates
cases.sql: SELECT r.k, r.tag, s.w FROM r JOIN s ON r.k = s.k
cases.note: NULL = NULL is not true, so NULL keys never join; 2 x 2 duplicate matches give 4 rows.

cases.name: left_join_group
cases.sql: SELECT r.k, COUNT(s.w) AS nw, SUM(s.w) AS total FROM r LEFT JOIN s ON r.k = s.k GROUP BY r.k
cases.note: Outer join (outside the accepted core; evidence only): unmatched rows padded with NULL, counted by COUNT(s.w) as 0.

cases.name: not_in_with_null
cases.sql: SELECT k FROM r WHERE k NOT IN (SELECT k FROM s)
cases.note: s.k contains NULL, so NOT IN is never true: empty result.

cases.name: exists_correlated_duplicates
cases.sql: SELECT r.k, r.tag FROM r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s WHERE s.k = r.k)
cases.note: EXISTS keeps each outer row once (two matches do not multiply it); the duplicate outer row stays twice.

cases.name: result_types_and_scales
cases.sql: SELECT v * v AS v_sq, v + 1 AS v_plus_int, k * 2 AS k_times_int, 0.06 - 0.01 AS lit FROM r WHERE k = 3
cases.note: numeric*numeric adds scales (4), numeric+integer keeps 2, integer*integer stays integer, literal arithmetic keeps scale 2.

cases.name: sum_integer_is_bigint
cases.sql: SELECT SUM(w) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(w) AS nw FROM s

cases.name: text_bpchar_c_collation
cases.sql: SELECT CAST('ab' AS char(4)) AS padded, CAST('ab' AS char(4)) = 'ab' AS pad_ignored, 'a' < 'B' AS c_order, length(CAST('ab' AS char(4))) AS bpchar_len
cases.note: char(n) prints padded but compares and measures without trailing blanks; C collation orders by bytes, so 'B' < 'a'.

cases.name: division_by_zero
cases.sql: SELECT k / 0 AS boom FROM r WHERE k = 1
cases.note: Run-time SQL error: recorded as sql_error with SQLSTATE, not a harness failure.
